metadata.name: Suppressors Enhanced — Standalone
metadata.description: Launcher-independent GTA V Enhanced Story Mode build. The ALLIN1 launcher remains the recommended installation and configuration path.
metadata.largeDescription: Installs the standalone RealisticSuppressors.dll, a settings example, and the rs_suppressor_heat add-on DLC. Requires ScriptHookV, ScriptHookVDotNet 3, and OpenRPF. This build does not load or reference ALLIN1.dll.
